newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for March 11.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for March 11.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open Tuesday, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily meteorological report.
Salina Cruz in Oaxaca state was closed to smaller tourism and fishing craft.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.
Warm temperatures with maximum winds from 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 17 miles per hour) and waves three to six feet high.
A weak cold front in the northern gulf region dissipating. Light moderate rains with winds mostly from 10 to 15 knots and waves three to five feet along the coast.
Hot and partly cloudy with moderate eastern and southeastern winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
